title: Reviewers sign in by key variable only
summary: The reviewer launch path stops copying login files out of the real home. `login_paths` disappears from the agent list and from `Reviewer`, `RunHome::seed_login` and its copy helpers are deleted, and `run_one_noted` collapses back into `run_one` with an empty notes list. In their place a single gate, `missing_credential`, runs before any child is spawned: a reviewer whose `credential_env` is empty, or none of whose variables is set to a non-empty value, returns could-not-run with a reason that names the variable and never its value. Tests and docs move with it — the fake harnesses now declare a dummy key, and the docs state that osf never copies a login file.

nodes.label: review_run
nodes.subtitle: Attempts::run
nodes.summary: Drives one reviewer attempt and records the outcome. It no longer asks for notes: it calls `reviewers::run_one` and stores an empty notes vector, since the only note source (a missing login path) is gone.

nodes.label: Attempt
nodes.subtitle: result, reason, notes
nodes.summary: The per-attempt record. Its `notes` field stays in the shape but is now always empty; the doc comment drops the login-path example. A credential failure arrives as `result: could-not-run` with the reason string instead.

nodes.label: run_one
nodes.subtitle: pub fn run_one(..) -> Outcome
nodes.summary: The public entry point. It is now a thin wrapper over `run_with_retry`; the `run_one_noted` variant that returned notes is deleted, so callers get an `Outcome` and nothing else.

nodes.label: run_with_retry
nodes.subtitle: read-only check, credential gate, retry
nodes.summary: Checks the reviewer has a read-only mode, then the new credential gate, then runs the child and retries once on an invalid answer. It no longer threads `real_home` or a notes buffer through to the child.

nodes.label: missing_credential
nodes.subtitle: fn missing_credential(&Reviewer) -> Option<String>
nodes.summary: The new gate. Returns a reason when `credential_env` is empty, or when none of its variables is set to a non-empty value; returns `None` when one is. The reason names the variable or variables and never the value.

nodes.label: prepare_command
nodes.subtitle: builds Command + RunHome
nodes.summary: Creates the fresh home and assembles the child command with a cleared environment. It no longer seeds login files and no longer returns notes, so its signature loses `real_home` and the notes vector.

nodes.label: run_child
nodes.subtitle: one harness invocation
nodes.summary: Writes the prompt and schema temp files, prepares the command, spawns the harness and captures its output. The `real_home` and `notes` parameters are gone; the doc comment now says the home is empty and no login file is ever copied.

nodes.label: RunHome
nodes.subtitle: fresh home, removed on drop
nodes.summary: The temporary home a reviewer runs in. `seed_login` and the `real_home`/`copy_login`/`copy_dir` helpers are deleted, leaving create, apply, apply_temp and the drop-time removal.

nodes.label: Reviewer
nodes.subtitle: credential_env, no login_paths
nodes.summary: The runtime reviewer description. The `login_paths` field is removed and `credential_env`'s doc now states the reviewer does not start when none of its variables is set or the list is empty.

nodes.label: AGENTS
nodes.subtitle: the one list of agents
nodes.summary: The static registry of drivable agents. Every `login_paths` entry is dropped from the five review blocks, and the `Review` struct loses the field; `credential_env` is now the only sign-in channel. omp keeps an empty list, so it can never start as a reviewer.

nodes.label: Agent harness
nodes.subtitle: codex, claude, opencode, dsh
nodes.summary: The coding-agent CLI osf spawns headless. It starts with an allow-listed environment, its own credential variable, and a fresh empty home; it signs in through the key alone.

nodes.label: reviewers tests
nodes.subtitle: unit tests
nodes.summary: The login-copying tests are replaced by credential-gate tests: every reviewing agent without its key reports could-not-run and never starts, an empty variable counts as unset, and no agent's home holds a login file even when the real home is unreadable.

nodes.label: integration tests
nodes.subtitle: tests/review_run.rs, tests/reviewers.rs
nodes.summary: The fakes now supply a dummy value for every agent's credential variable, and the fake reviewer declares `OSF_FAKE_REVIEWER_KEY`, so the new gate does not stop the harnesses the tests rely on.

nodes.label: Docs and ADRs
nodes.subtitle: README, development.md, 0016, 0020
nodes.summary: Prose follows the code: osf never copies a login file, a reviewer signs in only through its key variable, and a missing variable means could-not-run with the variable named. The agent table gains a per-agent key-variable column.

edges.label: run_one(..)
edges.summary: The attempt loop calls the simplified entry point and no longer receives notes back.

edges.label: Outcome
edges.summary: `run_one` is now just `run_with_retry`, with no notes wrapper around it.

edges.label: gate before spawn
edges.summary: The connection the change is really about: before any child is prepared, the run asks whether the reviewer has a credential and returns could-not-run when it does not.

edges.label: first run and retry
edges.summary: Both the first attempt and the retry call `run_child` without a real home or notes buffer.

edges.label: (Command, RunHome)
edges.summary: The child asks for a prepared command and home; the tuple no longer carries notes.

edges.label: RunHome::create
edges.summary: The home is created empty and nothing is seeded into it; the seeding path is deleted.

edges.label: spawn, stdin prompt
edges.summary: The harness is spawned with the allow-listed environment and its own credential variable, in the empty home.

edges.label: from_agent
edges.summary: A `Reviewer` is built from an `AGENTS` entry; the `login_paths` copy is gone, so `credential_env` is the only sign-in data carried across.

edges.label: credential_env
edges.summary: The gate reads the reviewer's declared variable names and checks the process environment for a non-empty value.

edges.label: no key, no start
edges.summary: New tests assert every reviewing agent without its key reports could-not-run and that the harness never starts.

edges.label: dummy keys
edges.summary: The integration fakes set a dummy value for each agent's credential variable so the new gate lets the fake harnesses run.

edges.label: could-not-run
edges.summary: The README, development guide and both ADRs now describe the key-variable-only sign-in and the could-not-run outcome.
